item: Row J R167: a catalogue value for a field the row holds at the column default is applied, not listed as an operator edit
refs: R167; R100; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: The independent read of the J3 final head found sync_catalogue_corrections forgave the column default only when a catalogue stops shipping a field. A row made from an entry with no region or source_type holds the default with a baseline of None; when the catalogue later ships a value it was listed as an operator edit and never applied (1,807 of 5,580 entries ship no region, 3,140 no source_type). A live value equal to the default with a baseline of None now counts as never edited. Known limit, pinned by a test and named in OPEN_QUEUE: the app keeps no per-field record of operator edits, so a value typed exactly as the default is taken for untouched. Four tests, red without the change, one on the real sources.yml shape (0 false conflicts, every fill applied).
